findings.title: Exact liver thresholds
findings.description: ALT/AST>2.5×ULN orbilirubin>3×ULN for capecitabine; use measuredULNmultiples, notgrade3proxy. Severe lapatinib liver toxicity permanently discontinues with no retreatment. Legacygrades require measured-result clarification.

findings.title: QT and LVEF source fidelity
